backlog.spec: Replace Morgan bits with all RDKit Descriptors.CalcMolDescriptors (about 210 values) per molecule. Replace NaN/inf with 0 and clip to +-1e6. Keep RandomForest with max_features=0.3. Descriptors such as TPSA, logP and HBD are known to drive permeability.
backlog.title: RDKit 2D descriptors + RF

backlog.spec: Concatenate RDKit 2D descriptors with Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 1024 bits, count simulation). Fit RF on the combined matrix after NaN cleaning.
backlog.title: Descriptors + count Morgan concatenated

backlog.spec: Use RDKit 2D descriptors with LGBMRegressor: n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=15, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.5, min_child_samples=10, random_state=seed, n_jobs=8.
backlog.title: LightGBM on descriptors

backlog.spec: Fit CatBoostRegressor (depth 6, 800 iterations, lr 0.03, loss MAE or RMSE, random_seed=seed, thread_count=8, verbose=0) on RDKit descriptors, NaN-cleaned.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Switch the gradient boosting objective to L1 or Huber, since the metric is MAE and the targets have outliers. Use a LightGBM or XGBoost model on descriptors with objective='huber' or 'l1'.
backlog.title: MAE objective

backlog.spec: Replace RF with ExtraTreesRegressor (500 trees, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=2) on descriptors plus Morgan counts.
backlog.title: Extra trees on descriptors

backlog.spec: Average predictions of an RF, a LightGBM and a CatBoost, all fit on descriptors plus Morgan counts. Use equal weights.
backlog.title: Ensemble RF + LGBM + CatBoost

backlog.spec: Use a small handcrafted set: TPSA, MolLogP, MolWt, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, NumRotatableBonds, FractionCSP3, ring counts, aromatic ring count, formal charge, and acid and basic group SMARTS counts (COOH, amines). Fit a GBM or RF. Small features reduce overfitting with 728 samples.
backlog.title: Targeted physchem feature set

backlog.spec: Add 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys) to the descriptor features, then fit RF.
backlog.title: MACCS keys added

backlog.spec: Use count-based AtomPair and TopologicalTorsion fingerprints (2048 bits each) in place of Morgan, with RF.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and topological torsion counts

backlog.spec: Use Morgan count fingerprints (radius 3, 2048 bits) with the feature-invariant atom generator (FCFP). Fit RF.
backlog.title: Feature-count Morgan with chirality/features

backlog.spec: Compute the Tanimoto kernel on Morgan count fingerprints and fit sklearn SVR(kernel='precomputed', C=5, epsilon=0.1). Build the train-train and test-train kernels manually.
backlog.title: SVR with Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Kernel ridge regression with a Tanimoto kernel on Morgan counts, alpha=0.5. Center y by the train mean before fitting and add it back.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge / GP Tanimoto

backlog.spec: Standardize RDKit descriptors, using a clipped QuantileTransformer or StandardScaler fit on train only, and fit SVR(rbf, C=3, gamma='scale', epsilon=0.1).
backlog.title: SVR RBF on scaled descriptors

backlog.spec: On the training descriptors, drop constant columns and columns with abs correlation above 0.95. Then fit RF or LGBM on the rest.
backlog.title: Descriptor variance and correlation filter

backlog.spec: Use 500 trees, min_samples_leaf=2, max_features=0.2 or sqrt, and max_samples=0.8 on the current fingerprint. A quick regularization tweak.
backlog.title: RF hyperparameter retune

backlog.spec: Take the median of per-tree predictions from the RF rather than the mean. This suits MAE and is robust to outliers.
backlog.title: Median-based RF aggregation

backlog.spec: Clip train_y to the 2nd and 98th percentiles before fitting, to reduce the effect of outliers on MAE-trained models.
backlog.title: Winsorize training targets

backlog.spec: XGBRegressor with 600 trees, max_depth 4, lr 0.03, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.4, reg_lambda 5, objective reg:pseudohubererror, n_jobs 8.
backlog.title: XGBoost on descriptors + counts

backlog.spec: Build out-of-fold predictions inside fit_predict (5-fold on train) for RF, LGBM and SVR. Fit a non-negative linear regression on them and apply it to the test predictions from the base models refit on the full train set.
backlog.title: Stacking with ridge meta-learner

backlog.spec: Train 5 LightGBM models with different seeds, subsampling and colsample, on descriptors. Average them to reduce variance.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged boosting

backlog.spec: Add counts of carboxylic acid, basic amine, quaternary N, sulfonamide, phenol and amide SMARTS patterns, plus Crippen contributions (rdMolDescriptors.SlogP_VSA, SMR_VSA, PEOE_VSA lists). Fit GBM.
backlog.title: Ionization-state features

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, keep the largest fragment with rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser and neutralize charges with Uncharger. Apply this to every model.
backlog.title: Largest-fragment desalting

backlog.spec: Fit on a rank-gaussianized y via a quantile transform of train_y. Map predictions back by interpolating the sorted train_y.
backlog.title: Rank-transformed target

backlog.spec: Fit a first RF on descriptors plus fingerprints. Keep the top 200 features by importance, then refit the RF or LGBM on only those. Do it inside fit_predict on the train fold.
backlog.title: Feature selection by importance

backlog.spec: Add Avalon count fingerprints (pyAvalonTools, 1024 bits) and ErG fingerprints (rdReducedGraphs.GetErGFingerprint) to the descriptors. Fit RF.
backlog.title: Mordred-like extra: Avalon and ErG

backlog.spec: Fit sklearn MLPRegressor (128,64), alpha=1e-2, early_stopping, on quantile-transformed descriptors. Average 5 seeds.
backlog.title: Small MLP on descriptors

backlog.spec: Blend 0.5 RF (descriptors+counts) and 0.5 Tanimoto SVR predictions. Diverse model families usually help MAE.
backlog.title: Weighted blend of RF and SVR

backlog.spec: LightGBM with max_depth 3, num_leaves 8, 800 trees, lr 0.02, lambda_l2 10, min_child_samples 15, feature_fraction 0.3, on descriptors plus MACCS.
backlog.title: Shallow GBM with strong regularization

backlog.spec: Compute the Murcko scaffold per train molecule. Fit 20 small RFs, each on a random subset of scaffold groups (80%). Average them. This mimics the scaffold-split test and improves generalization to unseen skeletons.
backlog.title: Descriptor-only RF with scaffold-aware bagging

incumbent.description: Add a LightGBM regressor on all RDKit 2D descriptors as a third equal-weight member of the RF/SVR blend.
